title: Looren a Lavigny Fellowship for Literary Translators
description: A one-month literary translation residency at the Chateau de Lavigny in Switzerland, jointly offered by Translation House Looren and the Chateau de Lavigny writers' residence, aimed at published literary translators working from or into French. Translation House Looren offers four one-month residency grants worth CHF 1,500 each, plus free accommodation at the chateau, a historic residence overlooking Lake Geneva that has hosted international writers and translators since the 1960s. Open to applicants of any nationality who are fluent in English or French and have at least one traditionally published book (self-publication does not qualify). This is the call for the 2027 residency cycle; exact 2027 residency dates will be announced to selected fellows, following the pattern of prior years' sessions running in the spring.
org: Chateau de Lavigny / Translation House Looren
visaNote: This is a short-term literary residency, not employment; non-EU/EEA fellows should confirm Schengen short-stay visa requirements for the one-month residency period.
